files_summary.accounts.csv: CSV of bank accounts (account_id, name, type, balance, currency).
files_summary.transactions.csv: CSV of transactions (txn_id, account_id, date, amount, currency, category, description).
files_summary.expense_reports.json: Array of expense reports (report_id, employee, status, total, items).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: finance_get_transaction
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single transaction identified by txn_id and returns the transaction record when it exists; if it does not exist, it returns an explicit not-found result. It refuses requests missing txn_id or where txn_id is empty. It also refuses requests for transactions you are not allowed to view (for example, not associated with an account you can access).

tool_schemas.name: finance_list_transactions
tool_schemas.description: Lists transactions visible to you, optionally narrowed to a specific account_id and/or a category, and returns the matching set. It refuses requests that provide an empty account_id or category, or a category value the service does not recognize. It also refuses requests that attempt to list transactions for an account_id you do not have access to.

tool_schemas.name: finance_account_balance
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current balance and related account metadata for the specified account_id. It refuses requests missing account_id or where account_id is empty. It also refuses requests for accounts that do not exist or that you are not permitted to view.

tool_schemas.name: finance_submit_report
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new expense report for the given employee with the provided total and optional items count, and returns the created report record. It refuses requests missing required fields (employee or total), with an invalid employee identifier, with a non-numeric or negative total, or with an items value that is not an integer or is negative. It also refuses submissions that conflict with report state rules, such as attempting to submit a report for an employee you are not allowed to submit on behalf of.

metadata.name: Pinnacle Expense Ledger
metadata.description: A finance service that lets employees submit expense reports and enables teams to track transactions and account balances end to end.
